exact_blockers: Asset identity is not admitted: the ledger records g_best_streaming_fp32.onnx as 323489 bytes with SHA-256 64b18acee261d54805c7cbe6b01a23f806160cf594c7c3f6df621c3b50a343db under https://huggingface.co/claroche1/LiSenNet at source_revision '4fe3356', but that revision is a 7-hex abbreviation with no immutable full-commit retrieval record tying those bytes to it. The artifact is absent from this SDK worktree and must resolve from the caller's own storage; no bytes were read, hashed or downloaded.

The runtime is absent and unpinned: the streaming graph requires an ONNX Runtime CPU runtime for feat + 17 state inputs. onnxruntime is not installed in this environment and no pinned wheel/sdist digest or runtime distribution/product-use terms exist here. The host STFT, feature extraction and noisy-phase iSTFT in the research adapter are not vendored or executed.

Artifact-specific rights are not cleared: MIT is recorded for the port LICENSE and the model card, but written weight-specific terms, training-data provenance (beyond the VoiceBank-DEMAND reporting scope), redistribution/product-use clearance and legal review are absent. No weight, graph, runtime or upstream source may be copied, packaged, downloaded or redistributed by this package.

No qualification evidence exists: there is no rights-cleared paired real cohort with clean references, no independent STOI/SI-SDR scorer result, no permitted listening, no target-runtime pacing, availability, deadline or memory measurement, and no approved exact streaming reference output vector for these frozen inputs. The synthetic surrogate can never stand in for any of these.
